content.title: Here Are 3 Staffing Stocks to Consider Despite Industry Challenges
content.summary: The Zacks Staffing Firms industry is pressured by the economic headwind in the manufacturing sector. However, RGP, KFRC and HQI are likely to be at the forefront to witness steady service demand, and the increasing adoption of remote work and technology.

content.title: 3 Services Stocks Walking a Fine Line
content.summary: Business services providers play a critical role for enterprises, assisting them with everything from new hardware integrations to consulting and marketing. Furthermore, the demand for their offerings is rising as more clients outsource non-core functions, a trend that has enabled the industry to return 11.8% over the past six months, almost identical to the S&P 500.
